paragraphs: I'm a fourth year student at Far Eastern University - Alabang, taking a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology with a specialization in web and mobile applications. I build full-stack web and mobile apps: the interface people use, the backend behind it, and the deployment that keeps it live.

I focus on web and mobile development, system design, UI/UX design and machine learning. Most of what I know comes from building real projects: the web platform for my capstone, gameplay systems for a Roblox team, Java plugins for a Minecraft server with thousands of players, and Lakbay Lokal, a trip planner I'm building on my own.
contactLine: I'm open to frontend and full-stack internships.
